quake.definition:
n shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v shake with seismic vibrations
quake.translation:
vi. 颤抖, 地震
n. 颤抖, 地震

quaked.translation: v. 颤抖, （因害怕或寒冷而）发抖( quake的过去式和过去分词 ); （地面）震动

quaker.definition: n. one who quakes and trembles with (or as with) fear

quaker gun.translation: n. 瞒骗敌人用的木制假枪

quaker-ladies.translation: n. [植]矢车菊等之蓝色小花

quakeress.definition: n. A woman who is a member of the Society of Friends.
quakeress.translation: n. 贵格会教派女信徒

quakerish.definition: a. Like or pertaining to a Quaker; Quakerlike.
quakerish.translation: a. 像贵格会教派的, 谨严的

quakerism.definition: n the theological doctrine of the Society of Friends characterized by opposition to war and rejection of ritual and a formal creed and an ordained ministry

quakerly.translation: a. 似贵格会教徒的, 适于贵格会教徒的

quakers.definition:
n. a Christian sect founded by George Fox about 1660; commonly called Quakers
n. a member of the Religious Society of Friends founded by George Fox (the Friends have never called themselves Quakers)
n. one who quakes and trembles with (or as with) fear
quakers.translation: n. 贵格会；贵格会信徒（Quaker的复数）

quakes.definition:
n shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v shake with seismic vibrations
quakes.translation: v. 颤抖, （因害怕或寒冷而）发抖( quake的第三人称单数 ); （地面）震动

quaking.definition:
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v shake with seismic vibrations

quakingly.definition: adv. In a quaking manner; fearfully.

quaky.translation: a. 震动的, 摇动的
